title: Navbar (Konsta UI, iOS + Material)
notes:
Konsta UI Navbar example: mobile components made with Tailwind CSS that follow iOS and Material Design (Android) look and feel.

Use: npm i konsta (React, Vue or Svelte). Docs: https://konstaui.com

Original file: https://github.com/konstaui/konsta/blob/master/kitchen-sink/react/pages/Navbar.jsx
code:
import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Page, Navbar, NavbarBackLink, Link, Block, BlockTitle, BlockHeader, List, ListItem, Radio, Toggle, } from 'konsta/react'; export default function NavbarPage() { const [size, setSize] = useState('Default'); const [isTransparent, setIsTransparent] = useState(false); const isPreview = document.location.href.includes('examplePreview'); return ( history.back()} />} right={Right} />

Navbar is a fixed area at the top of a screen that contains Page title and navigation elements.

Size Medium and Large will collapse to usual size on page scroll {['Default', 'Medium', 'Large'].map((v) => ( setSize(v)} /> } /> ))} Transparent When navbar is transparent, its title and background will become visible on page scroll setIsTransparent(!isTransparent)} /> } />
